name: Gardeners
tagline: Vetted gardeners and landscaping professionals, managed entirely from your phone.
hook_body: Maintaining a pristine garden shouldn't require managing unreliable informal labour or worrying about estate security access. You need consistency, professionalism, and easy payment structures. Bouul connects you with ID-verified gardening professionals. Schedule recurring maintenance, communicate specific landscaping needs via chat, and handle all payments digitally without ever needing cash on hand.
pains: The weekly hassle of drawing cash to pay informal garden services.
Bouul handles all transactions digitally, automating payments upon successful completion of the job.
Security anxiety regarding who is actually entering your property.
Every gardening professional is strictly ID-verified, smoothing the process with estate security.
Inconsistent scheduling where the gardener simply doesn't show up.
Live tracking and transparent reliability ratings ensure you hire professionals who respect your time.
audience: Busy homeowners needing consistent weekly maintenance
Estate residents requiring highly vetted personnel
why_bodies: Never scramble for cash again. Approve the completed work and release digital payments instantly.
Access professionals with proven attendance records, backed by reviews from other local homeowners.
Provide your estate security with verified digital ID profiles, preventing gate delays.
trust: Digital payment gateways eliminating cash risks
Transparent reviews on punctuality and work ethic
faqs: Can I book the same gardener every week?
Yes, Bouul allows you to establish recurring bookings with the professional you prefer, ensuring consistency.
Do they bring their own equipment?
You can specify this when booking. Many professionals arrive fully equipped, while others offer labour-only rates if you provide the tools.
Does the service include the removal of garden refuse?
You can request refuse removal as part of the quote. The professional will confirm their capacity to transport waste before accepting the job.
